secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for AI features (builder, agent chat, portfolio rebalancer, image/video gen). Get from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) API keys. App boots without it but AI endpoints return fallbacks.

secrets.name: LIFI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. LI.FI API key for higher rate limits on cross-chain bridge/DEX aggregation. Get from li.fi.

secrets.name: ETHERSCAN_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Etherscan API V2 key for contract verification & gas oracle on Base/Ethereum. Get from etherscan.io.

secrets.name: BASESCAN_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. BaseScan-specific API key for Base L2 contract verification. Get from basescan.org.

secrets.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional. Secret for signing Better Auth tokens/cookies. Random long string; code has a dev default.
